Title: Reef & City Expeditions
Changes: Dive into Lumenreef Basin: swim freely, explore currents and discover a hidden cave.
Explore Bellspire Ward with independent grappling hooks and strike the colossal wardens' glowing cores.
Meet Nori and Vesper, two expedition heroes available from the start.
Play longer expeditions with friends, with shared resources and improved co-op synchronization.
Download and install future game updates directly from the main menu.
